findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; recorded affinities are removed and the label prior is equal-score, so no observed affinity outcome is available to rank coordinate hypotheses by benefit.

Across the observed window the continuous landmark contrast functions are non-monotone: every inspected feature shows multiple sign changes (4 to 10) with large first-vs-last rate z-scores of opposite sign, and no polynomial fit is accepted (extrapolation disallowed). This supports a time-conditioned contrast rule over a constant rule, but the curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets.

Several landmark features carry strong sign conflicts (up to 14) and relative node RMSE up to ~0.87, indicating unstable or redundant marginal descriptors; isolated marginal contrasts should not be averaged into an unsupported target without joint/covariance diagnostics.

hypotheses.falsifier: If the time-conditioned rule does not reduce relative node RMSE or sign-conflict count versus the constant rule on held-out observed nodes, the hypothesis fails.
hypotheses.observable: landmark soft-mass and local displacement contrast features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], predicted endpoint world coordinates
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe (validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes) better expresses the observed non-monotone landmark contrast structure than a constant static rule, while keeping the shared FLOWR endpoint and no velocity target.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or observed affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-vs-descendant comparison is unavailable.
Joint covariance/intact-conformation diagnostics were not read in this turn, so coupling versus redundant marginal evidence remains unresolved.
Turnover and increment accounting tables were not inspected; within-path change versus cohort-composition change is not established here.
All cited contrasts are coordinate descriptors, not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
